notes: Only exact integer-token unit syntax accepted; n1.0/1e0/2.0/2e0 rejected INVALID_BRIEF, even when mathematically integral. No claim that all integer numeric representations are supported.

Top-level n JsonDecimal including long exponent tokens now receives422INVALID_BRIEF instead of generic409. Token is not expanded/coerced; MAX_BODY remains bounded. Therefore numeric error classifications are not wholly unchanged.
Other integer/string length and precision limits, duplicate/nonfinite and depth limits remain independent; W/L JSON decimal rejection unchanged.
